name: research-router
description: Keeps bulky web research out of the main chat: condenses large web search and fetch results on a cheap model, and adds /research-router, a short research job whose brief, with sources, is all the chat receives.

minChars.title: Condense above (characters)
minChars.description: A web search or fetch result longer than this is shortened by the helper model. Shorter results are left alone.

helperModel.title: Helper model
helperModel.description: The cheap model that condenses results, plans research parts and writes /research-router briefs: an alias such as haiku, or a full model id.

maxWorkers.title: Max research workers
maxWorkers.description: Upper bound on parallel workers one /research-router question is split into.

timeoutMs.title: Helper timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long one helper-model call may take. Past it a condensation keeps the original result, and a research part gets no brief.

blockedHosts.title: Blocked hosts
blockedHosts.description: Comma-separated host names /research-router never fetches, each with its subdomains (for example: example.com, tracker.net). Private, local and non-http(s) links are always refused.
